bioLong: I'm Tanishq, a junior at Bayonne High School in Bayonne, NJ. I build small apps, automation scripts, and the occasional piece of hardware.

Most of my time right now goes into Holos, a personal health app that pulls in data from wearables. Before that I mostly built tools for myself, like a screen-time tracker, a Slack reminder bot, and a script that summarizes the morning announcements. A lot of it started with Hack Club.
_comment: Set launch to true when the site is finished. From then on, `npm run build` (and the GitHub deploy) fails if any placeholder is left. Run `npm run check:placeholders` to see the list.
